shellCommands.command: cat package.json && git diff package.json && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -not -path './.git/*' -print | head -50 && ls node_modules/next/package.json && grep '"version"' node_modules/next/package.json
cat app/page.tsx app/layout.tsx next.config.ts tsconfig.json; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rl "after" node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head
f=$(find node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app -name "after.md"); echo $f; cat $f; cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -40

(npx next start -p 3123 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4; curl -s -A "test-agent" http://localhost:3123/ | grep -o '

[^<]*

'; sleep 1; cat /tmp/next.log; pkill -f "next start" || true
